description: European Air Traffic dataset provides Eurostat-derived airport traffic flows processed for network analysis, with monthly, quarterly and annual series. The provider is Cem Ersöz, published through Mendeley Data. Geographical and temporal coverage: The metadata describe airports in 35 European countries; the deposit is version 1, published 5 August 2021. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the DataCite record of its DOI on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
